heading: ஆங்கில மொழிபெயர்ப்பு

O you with youths zeal after the play-ball
From your fathers ancient mansion
Opulence and towering glory marked,Making a parade
Of your rotund arms bamboo-stems like,
Five-stranded tresses fragrance emitting,
Timid looks unrivalled by a female deers,
A peafowls delicacy of gait marking your sway!
Moving about as you do
With your comely anklets inlaid bells jingling,
Your ornaments shedding bright sheen
And with your captivating furtive waist
A creeper-plant like, lightning like
And an afflicting celestial woman like,Do heed my words:
Your battering collyrium-laden eyes-
That excel the nilam buds
Opening out with honey flowing down
Thro the lofty Kutal of the Pantiya king
With sandal-smeared chest garlands of cool flowers adorned-
Resemble that monarchs reddened lance
